skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Explain the role of taxes in forming government budgets, regulating macroeconomic activities, and redistributing income.
Analyze the scope of impact of a type of tax and evaluate its role in income distribution.
Analyze and evaluate the efficiency of a tax system and specific types of taxes.
Evaluate the degree of optimality of a tax system and specific types of taxes such as personal income tax, corporate income tax, consumption tax, and property tax.
Collect data on Vietnam's tax system, evaluate the role of each type of tax in the total government revenue, and propose reforms based on comparisons with ASEAN countries.
Apply economic theories and models to analyze and determine the scope of impact, efficiency, and fairness of a type of tax.

Identify and analyze real-world data related to current tax policies domestically and internationally, and make rational choices about tax policies to achieve revenue generation goals, income distribution goals, economic efficiency goals, and trade-offs between these goals.

Develop independent work skills, including self-study, finding real-life situations about tax reforms in Vietnam and ASEAN countries, analyzing situations, working in groups, presenting, and debating.
Enhance self-learning and research abilities to accumulate knowledge.
Develop critical thinking skills to evaluate real-world issues and policies related to taxation and subsidies.
